craft_notes: Sthāyin: counting blessings. Device: end-dash→comma (boons stated softly, shoots released). Rejected: 'sapling' — killed: pallava shoots kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Fineness from the first, overlordship ever, birth's close,
these, Bhava, are love-tree shoots from thee.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Attainment of powers from aṇimā, eternal lordship, end of becoming.; These, O Bhava, are sprouts of devotion's wish-tree. → Powers, lordship, and end of becoming sprout from devotion.
c1_essence: Already won, yet when won: tell; clear-heart tenant, ash-white swan bowed.
reads_against.l2: Powers from the minute on, undying lordship, becoming's end — Bhava, these are green shoots of the prayer-tree rooted in you.
l3: Fineness from the first, overlordship ever, birth's close —
these, Bhava, are love-tree shoots from thee.
reads_against.t1: Attainment of powers from aṇimā onward, eternal lordship, end of becoming — these, O Bhava, are sprouts of the wish-tree of devotion to you.
